system.description: Stoic, loyal creator god of family and hard work, worshipped mostly by squats and dwarves, who wants followers to leave lasting works and despises destroying others' legacies.
system.summary: Stoic, loyal creator god of family and hard work, worshipped mostly by squats and dwarves, who wants followers to leave lasting works and despises destroying others' legacies.
commandments: Stay loyal to kin, clan, leaders and people.
Make something that endures, whether as crafter or ruler.
directives: Record events for posterity; erasing history, even an enemy's, is the worst shame.
You are one link in an unbroken lineage that defines your duty.
His people endure: they were here before and will remain after.
Do things properly and learn from the masters.
Keep traditions for every part of life; their origin matters less than keeping them.

cults.name: Ancestor Cults
cults.summary: Household ancestor worship, common among squats, treating Moradin as the eldest ancestor, sometimes sparking inherited feuds.

cults.name: The Stonecutters
cults.summary: An ancient guild-like brotherhood of builders behind many great structures, marking cornerstones with their crossed-tools triangle.
